analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see maintained. RSI continues oversold entry, ADX shows no trend. MACD histogram worsening. Lower High pattern confirmed with 5-day low < 20-day low and 5-day high < 20-day high. Price at 70,415 KRW approaches swing support at 68,045 KRW. With volatility ATR at 8,088 KRW, setting stop loss at 1.3x ATR (10,514 KRW) implies entry 70,415 KRW, stop 59,901 KRW, target 90,000 KRW. Risk/reward ratio is 1.86. However, ADX at 20.2 indicates no trend formation, thus wait-and-see.
